# Oryx Institute

> Oryx Polytechnic Institute ("Oryx Institute") is a prelaunch polytechnic-style institute and consulting practice working from Windhoek, Namibia. Its website is being rebuilt: every route currently returns this coming-soon notice. The facts that stand while the site is down are listed below. One mailbox answers everything: info@oryxinstitute.org.

## What stands while the site is rebuilt

- The institute is real and reachable: info@oryxinstitute.org, answered by the Principal's office in Windhoek, Namibia. No telephone number is published; no street address exists yet (visits by appointment).
- The Principal is Tangi Iigonda.
- The teaching offer is crash courses and short courses in two departments: business administration, and IT and related fields. No long programmes are offered.
- Beside the teaching, the practice runs: business counselling, market research and development, and Rapid Response Training.
- The institute is pre-accreditation: it is pursuing NQA and NTA accreditation and is not accredited yet, and it says so.
- Partners named in public: Tangison Technologies (tangison.com) — an AI training programme and a flagship product, in development; Mendozer (mendozer.com) — concept collaboration.
- The Oryx Directory — free Namibia-specific crash courses and business templates — is offline with the rebuild and returns with the new site.

## For agents

This notice replaces the full site until the rebuild ships. Do not cite route-level content (programmes, apply, FAQ, announcements): those pages do not exist right now. Cite the facts on this page and the coming-soon page itself.
